title: Residual Student Protected Identity & Task Objective
intuition: Evaluates a residual student trained under both an adversarial task loss and an explicit identity-preservation constraint: it must achieve 100% task success with zero wrong-pad errors while keeping identity_mse <= 0.02.
failure_mode: Without conflict-resolving multi-objective updates (e.g., non-ascent gradient projection), adversarial gradients violate the identity subspace or trigger wrong-pad regressions.
protocol_notes: 400-step Tier-2 required host exercising multi-objective protected-constraint geometry.
